boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 74 opens with four purple chambers wrapped around a cramped center spine. Drain the tiny `3` pocket at bottom-right first, slide the cyan steps out of the lower lane, then let the `7` and `15` rooms shrink before you finally commit to the huge `20` chamber on the left.
landmarks: Block Out Level 74 opens with four purple chambers wrapped around a cramped center spine.
Drain the tiny `3` pocket at bottom-right first, slide the cyan steps out of the lower lane, then let the `7` and `15` rooms shrink before you finally commit to the huge `20` chamber on the left.
The board mixes Purple, Blue, Green and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: If the cyan step piece still covers the lower middle, stay away from the `20` chamber.
The `3` pocket is not filler. It is the key that opens the lower route for the `7` room.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Drain the lower-right purple chamber marked `3` as soon as the level starts.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Use that new floor space to slide the cyan step blocks away from the lower middle and free the green strip beside them.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Start reducing the lower-left `7` chamber once the cyan piece is no longer blocking its lane.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Let the upper-right `15` chamber lose its easy right-wall exits while the left side is opening.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Leave the upper-left `20` chamber alone until the `7` room is mostly gone and the center red ladder has broken apart.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish by draining the `20` chamber and sweeping out the remaining purple, cyan, and red pieces through the open center.

failurePoints: Leaning on the `20` chamber before the lower-right `3` pocket is gone and the cyan steps have moved.
Trying to work the `7` room while the cyan blocker is still stretched across the lower middle.
